title: No Old Keys
story: Two office paths run north: one lined with inert legacy stations, the other lit by the skills the engineer already has. Ada says a locked tool need not mean a locked route. Every repaired ticket wakes a different lamp, and a coworker appears behind the glass.

steps.objective: Tell Ada whether practice is on at the start of the lit route.
Repair the left-hand ticket at the first station.
Repair the right-hand ticket at the second station.
Walk north along the lit route to the stair door landing.
Navigate the long ticket at the fourth station.
Edit and select at the fifth station.
Fix the changed-context ticket at the recall desk under the window.
Meet Ada at the north stair door.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Declare the practice state before the tickets: confirmed or unconfirmed. Every ticket stays playable either way.
success_criteria: The player answers "Practice layer: player-confirmed" or "unconfirmed"; both open the tickets.
The journal labels the evidence honestly (an unconfirmed run records output-observed evidence only).
The toggle sequence and the recovery cards are available on request, not shown by default.

task.prompt: Ada asks: is practice on? Answer from what you did, not from what the game can see.

steps.player_confirm: Practice layer: player-confirmed on / Practice layer: unconfirmed

steps.on_request: show the toggle sequence (B14) and the recovery cards (V06)

rejects: claiming the game detected the layer

feedback.unconfirmed: Recorded: unconfirmed. The tickets are open; the journal will mark this evidence as output-observed only.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Repair three tickets with the left-hand home-row holds: a Shift capital, a Command shortcut and a run of plain home-row letters.
success_criteria: Ticket 1 text equals "Mina moved the lamp" (Shift from tap-hold F, then M on the other hand).
Ticket 2 italic is on (Command from tap-hold D, then I on the other hand).
Ticket 3 text equals "dad said fast" with no modifier output (same-hand rolls stay letters).

task.prompt: Three raw tickets, left hand first. Physical Shift and Command are silent on practice.

items.accepts: resulting text equals the target; Shift observed as a modifier state on the M keydown
rejects: a stray f typed from the Shift hold

items.accepts: the editor toggles italic on a Command + I keydown (D held, then I)
rejects: Command + I with I on the same hand
any shortcut or capital from a roll
output that differs from a target

feedback.stray_f: Observed: f. The F hold was released too early and typed the letter.
feedback.same_hand: Observed: letters instead of a shortcut. Pick the other hand for the target key.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Repair three tickets with the right-hand home-row holds, then one mixed left and right approval form.
success_criteria: Ticket 1 equals "Sol approved the plan" (Shift from tap-hold J, then S).
Ticket 2 undo restores "ready" (Command from tap-hold K, then Z).
The mixed form equals "*Sol* signed" using Command + I (D, then I) for italic and Shift + S (J, then S).

task.prompt: Mirror the left-hand tickets with the right hand, then mix both hands.

items.accepts: a Command + Z keydown (K held, then Z) restores the earlier text
rejects: Command + Z with Z on the same hand

items.accepts: Shift + S (J then S) capitalizes, Command + I (D then I) wraps the name in italic
rejects: a shortcut that types letters on a same-hand roll
output that differs from a target

feedback.same_hand: Observed: letters instead of a shortcut. Pick the other hand for the target key.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Walk north along the lit Caps route with tap-hold Caps + H/J/K/L; no key from the old route works.
success_criteria: The avatar moves with Caps + H/J/K/L only (physical arrows and Right Command are silent on practice).
The walk ends at the north stair door landing; each press has a visible local reaction.

task.route: lit route B: strip (y 9-10), lane x 12-13 north, door landing (14-15, 4-6)
task.observed: Left, Down, Up and Right arrow events from Caps + H/J/K/L

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Move through a long ticket with Caps word, line, page and document jumps and fix three marked tokens.
success_criteria: Token A (line 3, found with Caps + W/B) reads "north" instead of "nroth".
Token B (the line end, reached with Caps + 4) ends with "." added.
Token C (the document end, reached with Caps + G) adds "ok" on the last line.

task.prompt: A 30-line raw ticket. Jump, do not hold arrows.
lines: (27 more lines of the ticket; page jumps cover them)

items.prompt: Fix the misspelled word on line 3.
items.accepts: Caps + W / Caps + B word jumps and Caps + M deletes, then letters

items.prompt: Add the full stop at the end of line 1.

items.accepts: Caps + G reaches the document end; Caps + T and Caps + U / Caps + D are used to find the other tokens

feedback.wrong_scope: Observed: the edit landed in the wrong line. Jump to the marked token first.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Open, select, delete both ways and cancel with the Caps editing set, then check that A, S and F stay letters under Caps.
success_criteria: The selected ticket opens with Caps + N (Return) and the cancel step with Caps + [ and with a tap of Caps (Escape).
A Shift selection started before Caps removes the marked phrase; both Backspace routes and both forward-delete routes are used once.
The typed result equals "fast desk" with a, s and f typed while Caps is held (literals).

task.prompt: Five small edits on one ticket list. Home-row Shift is held before Caps, never after.

items.accepts: Caps + [ (Escape) once, a tap of Caps (Escape) once

items.prompt: Remove the phrase "very old" with a Shift selection.
items.accepts: tap-hold F or J first, then Caps + B / Caps + W selects, Caps + M deletes

items.prompt: Fix the doubled letters using both Backspace routes and both forward-delete routes.
items.accepts: Caps + M and Caps + Space (Backspace), Caps + comma and Caps + X (Forward Delete / Control + D)

items.prompt: Type "fast desk" with Caps held while you press a, s and f.
items.accepts: A, S and F stay letters while Caps is held (N20)

feedback.late_shift: Observed: f. Hold Shift before Caps: once Caps is held, F types a literal f.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Recall desk under the long window: one changed-context ticket that needs a Shift capital, a Command shortcut, Caps movement, a selection and Return, with no key diagram.
success_criteria: The record equals "Kai closed the east lamp. Reported by Noor." at the end of the task.
No physical-position cue is shown; hints appear only on request.

task.prompt: A new ticket in a different layout. Fix it from memory.
task.initial:
kai closed the very old east lamp
reported by noor
task.target:
Kai closed the east lamp.
Reported by Noor.

steps.needs: Shift capitals on K, R, N (home-row Shift before the letter)
a Shift selection of "very old " then delete (Caps + M)
Caps + 4 to the line end, then the full stop; Caps + J / Caps + 0 between lines
Command + Z once on a deliberate wrong delete (opposite-hand key)

feedback.diff: Observed text differs from the record at line 1 or 2. The mismatch is shown, and you can retry instantly.

state_changes.before: Rows of identical dead desks; only the lit route has pools and arrows; every ticket lamp is off; the north stair and service doors are closed.
state_changes.after: Five lamps and a station glow along the lit route, a silhouette stands behind the ledger glass, the north stair and service doors are open, and Ada waits at the stair.

pace_copy.text: Walking is working. Walking is working.
Route A: approved. Route A: approved. Route A: approved.

review_notes: At 1366x768 (x4) the lit route runs north through rows 3-10, above the keyboard inset (view y >= 103 only covers the lower-left). The ticket terminals are approached from the strip (south) or the lane (north), so the target stays in the same column as the avatar or to its right, and the avatar sits at screen y 100, above the inset. The recall desk and station 5 sit on row 2-3 under the window. Documented conflicts: see the Keyboard-inset conflicts section of the level sheet.
